title: How to share a Post on Snapchat
description: It's quick and easy to add a post as a sticker to your Snap. There’s no need to take screenshots of posts to share what’s happening on >x< with your Snapchat friends. We’re doing the heavy lifting for you.

title: How to share a post to Snapchat

runs: A protected post cannot be shared.
If you’re signed into the Snapchat app on your device, your >x< app will close, and the camera feature of your Snapchat app will open.
The post you want to share will appear as a moveable and resizable sticker to share on Snapchat.
You can share the post with a single person, a group, or all of your followers.
Once posted, viewers of your post on Snapchat will be able to swipe up to see the original post and its replies on >x<.
